meta.title: VIACO | AI-Supported Knowledge Preservation and Structured Onboarding
meta.description: VIACO is developing a platform for organizational knowledge preservation, structured onboarding, and source-linked AI assistance.

hero.headline: Knowledge that stays. People who grow.
hero.subheadline: VIACO helps companies capture practical expertise from daily work, structure it for employee onboarding, and make verified knowledge accessible through an AI assistant with clear source citations.
hero.stageNote: VIACO is currently in development. We welcome companies in Austria for early concept discussions.

problem.headline: Why practical expertise gets lost in daily operations
problem.subheadline: In many organizations, critical operational know-how resides with individual specialists rather than in a structured system.

items.title: Practical expertise leaves with experienced staff
items.description: When senior specialists retire or change roles, years of troubleshooting intuition around equipment, workflows, and edge cases disappear if they were never captured.

items.title: Teams solve the same technical issues repeatedly
items.description: Proven fixes remain scattered across chats, emails, and folders, forcing colleagues to diagnose recurring issues from scratch.

items.title: Onboarding ties up senior specialists
items.description: Without a clear learning path, experienced colleagues must constantly pause productive work to explain routine procedures and operational rules.

solution.headline: One Platform. Knowledge That Stays.
solution.subheadline: VIACO brings structured onboarding, low-friction knowledge capture, governed retrieval, and role-based management together in one coherent workflow.

journey.name: VIACO Journey
journey.headline: Structured onboarding tailored to each role
journey.description: New employees follow clearly organized steps matched to their role and equipment. Each stage tracks progress transparently and connects directly to designated mentors.
benefits: Step-by-step paths tailored by role, system, or department
Transparent progress tracking across every milestone
journey.heroLinkLabel: View full concept screen in the hero section
journey.mentorRole: Direct Q&A within each onboarding step

capture.name: VIACO Capture
capture.headline: Capture practical experience by voice or text
capture.description: Right after completing a task, specialists describe the problem, steps taken, and outcome by voice note or text. AI produces a structured draft that a human reviews, edits, and confirms before publication.
benefits: Fast logging by voice or text without lengthy report forms
Automatic structuring into problem, root cause, and verification steps
Mandatory human confirmation or editing prior to release

memoryAssistant.name: VIACO Memory & AI Assistant
memoryAssistant.headline: Store approved knowledge and retrieve answers with sources
memoryAssistant.description: Approved entries form an organized, permission-aware knowledge base. In daily work, the AI assistant answers technical questions strictly from approved records and always cites the underlying source.
memoryAssistant.memoryDesc: Approved records stay organized with technical metadata, lifecycle status, and access permissions.
memoryAssistant.assistantDesc: Answers natural-language questions with source citations and flags clearly when no verified record exists.
memoryAssistant.schematicQuestion: “Why is product-detail caching constantly returning cache misses in staging?”
memoryAssistant.schematicAnswer: Per the approved entry from Nov 18, 2026, an incorrect database index (REDIS_DB) caused the issue in staging. Updating the variable restored caching.

management.name: VIACO Management
management.headline: Manage onboarding paths, progress, and access rights
management.description: As the administrative capability within the same platform, VIACO Management lets team leads assign onboarding paths by role or department, monitor progress, coordinate mentors, and govern access permissions.
benefits: Assign onboarding paths cleanly by role or department
Clear overview of ongoing onboarding and open steps
Clean separation between new-joiner views and access management

howItWorks.headline: From field experience to shared team knowledge in four steps
howItWorks.subheadline: Every contribution passes through human review before teams rely on it in daily operations.

steps.title: Share experience
steps.description: A specialist describes a solved issue by voice note or text directly after completing the task.

steps.title: Review AI draft
steps.description: AI structures symptom, root cause, and resolution. The contributor reviews and refines the draft.

steps.title: Approve knowledge
steps.description: After explicit confirmation and permission tagging, the entry enters the governed knowledge base.

steps.title: Use in daily work and onboarding
steps.description: Teams query the source-linked AI assistant on the job or include lessons in onboarding paths.

howItWorks.exampleBody: After a deployment, product-detail caching in staging produces continuous cache misses. Neither restarting Redis nor flushing the cache fixes the issue until inspecting the REDIS_DB variable reveals the wrong database index. VIACO Capture structures this finding into a reviewable draft, which enters the knowledge base only after human confirmation.

whoWeHelp.headline: Who VIACO is built for
whoWeHelp.subheadline: During market validation, we focus deliberately on two technical environments where practical expertise drives daily operations.

groups.title: Industrial maintenance and technical field service
groups.description: Organizations where equipment availability, shift handovers, and maintenance rely on the hands-on experience of seasoned technicians.
points: Preserving practical equipment know-how ahead of retirements
Capturing recurring fault patterns quickly in the field
Structured onboarding for new service and maintenance technicians

groups.title: Technical teams and software engineering
groups.description: Engineering and operations teams where system configurations, deployment details, and architectural context otherwise stay buried in tickets and chats.
points: Reliable handovers of project and infrastructure knowledge
Clear onboarding paths for new engineers

trustDeployment.headline: Governance, privacy, and planned deployment options
trustDeployment.subheadline: All platform capabilities are under development. We clearly separate architectural design principles from planned hosting options.

governanceItems.title: Human approval before release
governanceItems.description: Unreviewed drafts never become team knowledge automatically. Every captured experience requires explicit confirmation.

governanceItems.title: Role-based access control
governanceItems.description: AI assistant retrieval and onboarding content are designed around defined role and department permissions.

governanceItems.title: Source-linked answers
governanceItems.description: AI responses cite approved internal entries and state clearly when no verified information exists.

governanceItems.title: Data minimization and GDPR by design
governanceItems.description: European data protection requirements guide the product architecture from the ground up.

deploymentItems.title: Public website and customer platform separated
deploymentItems.description: This validation website is hosted on Vercel. Future customer workspaces are architecturally separate and support independent hosting.

deploymentItems.title: EU cloud, dedicated hosting, and on-premise under evaluation
deploymentItems.description: Depending on security requirements and architecture, EU-hosted cloud environments, dedicated instances, and on-premise options are being evaluated.

deploymentItems.title: Planned access channels (Web, Desktop, Mobile)
deploymentItems.description: A browser-based web application is the starting point. Desktop and mobile apps are part of the roadmap and are not yet available.

about.headline: About VIACO
about.intro: VIACO is an early-stage software and AI initiative in Austria focused on keeping operational expertise usable over time and onboarding new employees with clarity.
about.detail: We prioritize clear workflows over isolated point tools: low friction when recording field experience, human review before every publication, and transparent source citations in daily work. We are currently engaging with companies in Austria to shape the platform directly around real workflows.
about.visionQuote: “Operational knowledge should remain alive, trustworthy, and useful long after the people who earned it have moved on.”

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy (Datenschutzerklärung)
datenschutz.subtitle: Information on personal data processing under the EU GDPR and Austrian TKG 2021

sections.heading: 1. Controller and Contact
sections.body: The controller responsible for personal data processing on this website is the VIACO project (contact: office@viaco.at). Current entity status and legal notice disclosures are listed in the Impressum.

sections.heading: 2. Hosting on Vercel and Server Connection Logs
sections.body: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. (440 N Barranca Ave #4133, Covina, CA 91723, USA). When accessing pages, hosting infrastructure processes technically necessary connection metadata (e.g., IP address, timestamp, requested path, user agent) in server logs to ensure availability and security (legal basis: Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Any international data transfers rely on appropriate safeguards under Art. 44 et seq. GDPR.

sections.heading: 3. Cookieless Reach and Performance Measurement (Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights)
sections.body: To monitor technical reliability and understand aggregated usage, this site uses Vercel Web Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights. These tools operate without advertising cookies and never receive names, email addresses, or form content. Query parameters are stripped prior to transmission, and Do Not Track (DNT) as well as Global Privacy Control (GPC) browser signals are respected. You can disable telemetry in this browser at any time using the control below.

sections.heading: 4. Contact and Concept Demo Inquiries
sections.body: When submitting the Request a Concept Demo form, we process your name, business email, company name, and optional entries (company size, primary challenge, message) solely to review and respond to your inquiry (Art. 6(1)(b) and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). No marketing newsletter subscriptions are bundled with this form. Technical error logs on the API endpoint strip all personal contact fields.

sections.heading: 5. Retention and Your GDPR Rights
sections.body: Inquiry details are retained only as long as needed to coordinate our discussion or fulfill statutory retention duties. You have rights of access (Art. 15), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and objection (Art. 21 GDPR) via office@viaco.at. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Österreichische Datenschutzbehörde, Barichgasse 40 to 42, 1030 Vienna, dsb.gv.at).
